clue.text: Excessively bulky when including everything

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means both grossly overweight and the whole amount before deductions, as in gross income or gross weight.

clue.text: Plucky in sport of any kind

explanation.surface: Praise for someone who shows courage in whatever sport they try.

clue.text: Eccentric novelist destroys miscellaneous articles

clue.text: Example of a man finally moving up bit by bit

clue.text: Leave before taking in rector's formal garden

clue.text: Departs with ninth earl to ramble in remote area

clue.text: Consider giving up a bit of territory to bring about agreement

clue.text: Abandoned team-mates tie without Henry nevertheless

clue.text: Foolishly in contempt over the introduction of evidence when not legally qualified

clue.text: Cover over swimming pool

clue.text: In favour of poet's publicity campaign

Andrew Motion, a former Poet Laureate

explanation.surface: Supporting a poet's drive to publicise his new book.

clue.text: Discuss the earliest of explorations around Iceland in a written composition
